scope_note: rustre-yara-rules exposes metadata parsing, validation, quality scoring, repo stats, saturating casts. These helpers have NO direct MCP tool surface — the closest MCP tools (yara.compile/scan_file/scan_memory) live in rustre-yara-engine. Comparison therefore covers (a) validator self-test, (b) MCP engine round-trip for rule-structure validation overlap.

tests.desc: Well-formed rule compiles in MCP and parses in validator.

tests.note: MCP yara.compile accepted a rule with an unresolved condition token. Out of rustre-yara-rules scope (engine-side compile leniency).

tests.desc: MCP yara.scan_file reports matched:false for a file containing the rule's literal string. Reproduces both with and without ruleset_id from prior yara.compile call. Engine bug, NOT rustre-yara-rules scope.
tests.evidence: rule Demo_Rule { strings: $a = "evil_marker_xyz" condition: $a }  vs  file 'prefix evil_marker_xyz suffix' -> {matched:false,match_count:0}

fix_note: The single mismatch is in rustre-yara-engine (yara.scan_file always returns matched:false), not in rustre-yara-rules. Task scope is rustre-yara-rules; engine fix deferred to a dedicated rustre-yara-engine validation run.
